smes.name: Ruang Halal
smes.productCategory: Digital Technology for the Halal Industry Ecosystem — HalalTech and Halal Compliance Platform
smes.brief: Ruang Halal is a HalalTech startup building an integrated digital ecosystem that helps MSMEs, industry players and international companies meet halal standards, access markets and expand into domestic and global markets. Through its Halal Smart System, Ruang Halal brings together halal certification assistance, the AI-based Halal Copilot, a halal product marketplace, a Halal Export Hub, HalalMaps and halal supply-chain traceability. Since its founding in 2020, Ruang Halal has assisted more than 300 businesses and helped around 250 MSMEs obtain halal certificates, serving companies from Indonesia, South Korea, China and Malaysia. The company aims to become the halal digital infrastructure connecting businesses, halal supervisors, consumers, global buyers, halal inspection bodies, government and strategic partners in one trusted and scalable ecosystem.

smes.supportingOrg: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
smes.brief: Crustea is a technology innovation company transforming traditional aquaculture through the integration of smart IoT, artificial intelligence and renewable energy. Its flagship product is an environmentally friendly solar-powered aerator equipped with a smart pond monitoring and control system, allowing farmers to track water quality, energy efficiency and production cycles in real time from any device. Crustea builds a complete upstream-to-downstream aquaculture ecosystem: pond construction and pre-stocking preparation, full farm management through its Aquagrowth model, and market access for local premium channels and global export. The company aims to raise farmer productivity, strengthen Indonesian food security and build a sustainable, modern and globally competitive aquaculture ecosystem.

smes.name: Tax Point
smes.brief:
Tax problems rarely start with tax. They start with business decisions.

Tax Point is an AI-powered tax solution combining the speed of artificial intelligence with the professional judgment of tax consultants, helping individuals, entrepreneurs and businesses understand, manage and resolve Indonesian tax matters in a way that is more accessible, affordable and on point. Good tax service should not force users to choose between a fast answer and advice they can trust; Tax Point is therefore built on AI & Human Collaboration: AI gives you speed, experts give you judgment.

Through Taxpert AI, users get 24/7 tax assistance developed specifically to understand the Indonesian tax context. Taxpert does not simply give generic answers — it uses confirmatory questions to understand the user's situation before responding. smes.name: RAVPhene by Ravelware Technology
smes.productCategory: Advanced Materials for Industry, Based on Waste Upcycling
smes.brief:
The first startup in Southeast Asia with patented flash plasma technology producing high-performance graphene supermaterial from plastic waste and used cooking oil, supplying it as an advanced material in applied formulations across industrial sectors (paints and coatings, polymer composites, super concrete, batteries, defence equipment, aircraft components). Graphene is the strongest, thinnest and most conductive carbon-chain material available today; RAVPhene (Ravelware Graphene) is a few-layer grade with 2–5 layers and over 90% purity.

Through this technology, shredded plastic waste worth around IDR 10,000/kg can be transformed into one of the most valuable advanced materials in industry today (USD 5–20/gram), delivering real circular-economy impact for Indonesia's future.

smes.name: 1010dry
smes.brief:
"Behind the Fragrance of Clean Clothes: The Hidden Risk of Laundry Businesses That Are Not Yet Halal and Ritually Pure"

Consider a scenario that plays out every day around us: a mother entrusts her best clothing, her husband's koko shirt and her prayer garment to a laundry business. The clothes come back neat, perfectly folded and fragrant. To the eye, they look clean.

But does clean necessarily mean ritually pure (suci)?

That is the concern laundry operators often overlook.

Time to transform: from merely clean to halal and pure. A laundry business is not just about spinning machines and printing receipts — it is a trust to safeguard the ritual purity of people's clothing. Providing certainty of halal and thaharah is no longer optional or a trend, but an urgent need to protect the business from doubt, maintain customer trust and ensure every rupiah earned carries genuine blessing.

smes.name: Terapan.id
smes.brief:
Terapan ID is an e-learning provider helping Indonesian engineers reach the skill level industry demands, through online On the Job Training (OJT).

The skill gap between universities and industry is a long-standing problem in Indonesian education. The fix is straightforward: let new graduates work on real projects and their skills align completely. That method is On the Job Training.

The difficulty is that OJT is normally only available to employees, and companies do not always have capacity to run it. Terapan ID therefore delivers OJT-style training to the public, packaged as e-learning so it can reach far more people.
smes.useOfFunds: Develop 100 new topics from the 20 existing topics, for the pre-seed stage.
